rationale: C04 is a near-verbatim predecessor using the same recital sequence, the same National Mediation Board finding, the same thirty-day reporting requirement, and the same Section 10 status-quo mechanism. Its language, structure, issuing president, and formulation referring to deprivation of “a section of the country” closely match the child, with principally the carrier and labor organization changed. C15 and C23 are nearly as strong but slightly less recent.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Spokane, Portland and Seattle Railway Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pennsylvania Railroad, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, C.I.O., Railroad Division, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same opening formula identifies a carrier, represented employees, and their labor organization, with the parties substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the Country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: These two substantive predicates are essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by Section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Spokane, Portland and Seattle Railway Company, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pennsylvania Railroad, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory status-quo machinery is reproduced verbatim apart from capitalization and substitution of the carrier.
